name: TyDi QA: Typologically Diverse Question Answering Benchmark
description: TyDi QA is a multilingual question answering benchmark covering 11 typologically diverse languages with over 204,000 question-answer pairs. To avoid translation artefacts, questions are written by native speakers seeking information before knowing the answer, spanning Arabic, Bengali, English, Finnish, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Swahili, Telugu, and Thai.
